fields.graphics_driver: panvk-r3lm (rc3-lowmem). Identical results also with: panvk-minegraph / Wrapper + bcn_layer / Wrapper + compat + bcn
fields.repro: Cold start via the shortcut. Godot splash renders fine. Then the title screen shows only the text "press any key" on a flat color, the main menu shows only 4 small text items, and the in-game dialogue shows the dialogue box plus text. Text and solid-color panels render; EVERY image asset (backgrounds, character sprites, icons, button art) never renders. Mouse input works (clicks advance the dialogue), Vulkan init completes, no assert.
fields.tried:
- Graphics drivers tried with pixel-identical results: panvk-r3lm (rc3-lowmem), panvk-minegraph, Wrapper + bcn_layer, Wrapper + compat + bcn.
- Copied the whole 1.8 GB game to the container's C: drive (native app storage): no change (so it is not shared-storage streaming).
- WRAPPER_BCN_ASTC=1 (On) and WRAPPER_BCN_GPU=0 (CPU) per the in-app About text: no change. Also tried BCN_COMPUTE_AUTO=0 (force explicit settings) with Wrapper + bcn_layer: no images, and clicks stopped advancing the game.
- Renderer OpenGL vs Vulkan: identical picture.
- Restoring the wrapper's clip-distance patch: no change.
- wine_debug.log (WINEDEBUG=+warn,+err,+fixme,+loaddll) shows NO Godot errors and NO Vulkan validation errors for the missing draws -> the game believes it rendered fine, so this looks like a silent PanVK/Mali draw failure.
- Container env: WRAPPER_NO_PATCH_OPCONSTCOMP=1, DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute=0, WRAPPER_BCN_GPU=0, WRAPPER_BCN_ASTC=1, BCN_COMPUTE_AUTO=0, MESA_SHADER_CACHE_MAX_SIZE=512MB, GALLIUM_DRIVER=zink, MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE=4.5, LIBGL_DEBUG=verbose, TU_DEBUG=noconform sysmem, DXVK_HUD=fps, DXVK_LOG_LEVEL=info, VKD3D_SHADER_MODEL=6_6, WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d11,dxgi,d3d10core,d3d9=n,b
  (WRAPPER_NO_PATCH_OPCONSTCOMP=1 was REQUIRED to stop a vkCreateShaderModule assert and let the Godot splash render at all.)
